title: ATP/WTA Tennis Match Winner Monte Carlo + Kalshi

includeMarketComparison.title: Compare against Kalshi
includeMarketComparison.description: Fetch live KXATPMATCH/KXWTAMATCH prices and compute edge/value verdicts. Turn off for a model-only run (no Kalshi calls).

iterations.title: Monte Carlo iterations
iterations.description: Simulations run per LIVE match (matches already in progress). Pre-match projections use an exact closed-form calculation and ignore this.

rankingSensitivity.title: Ranking sensitivity (k)
rankingSensitivity.description: Bradley-Terry exponent on ranking points. 1.0 = plain points ratio (the calibrated default, 24 Sep 2026). Higher makes the model more confident in the higher-ranked player; lower flattens it.

strengthUncertainty.title: Strength uncertainty blend
strengthUncertainty.description: Blends the raw ranking-based probability toward a coin flip (0 = trust the model fully, 1 = always 50/50). Hedges against surface, form and H2H that ranking points alone can't see.

unrankedPoints.title: Unranked player points floor
unrankedPoints.description: Ranking points assigned to a player with no current ATP/WTA ranking (qualifier, wildcard, outside the top 150).

edgeThreshold.title: Edge threshold for VALUE
edgeThreshold.description: Minimum fee-adjusted edge (model probability minus Kalshi ask minus fee) to mark a row VALUE instead of WATCH.

bankroll.title: Bankroll (USD)
bankroll.description: Used only to size suggested Kelly stakes. Leave at 0 to see edges without position sizing.

maxPerPositionPct.title: Max stake per position (fraction of bankroll)

minMarketOpenInterest.title: Minimum Kalshi open interest
minMarketOpenInterest.description: Markets with less open interest than this are marked ILLIQUID instead of being scored for edge. Most match-winner markets sit near zero until the day of the match.

maxMatchesPerLeague.title: Max matches per tour (0 = no cap)

includeQualifying.title: Include qualifying rounds
includeQualifying.description: Off by default: qualifying-round matches rarely have a Kalshi KXATPMATCH/KXWTAMATCH market, so including them adds chargeable rows with no market comparison.

archiveToNamedDataset.title: Archive to a named dataset
archiveToNamedDataset.description: Optional. If set, every row is ALSO appended to a named dataset with this name (kept indefinitely, unlike the default 31-day run dataset) for building a running history.
